name: trait PinCoerceUnsized
rule: If a type implementing `PinCoerceUnsized` implements `Deref`, the concrete type returned by `deref` and `deref_mut` must not change without a modification. Moving the pointer, performing unsizing coercions on the pointer, performing dynamic dispatch with the pointer, and calling `deref` or `deref_mut` on the pointer do not count as modifications. The concrete type of a trait object is the type corresponding to its vtable; the concrete type of a slice is an array of the same element type and the length specified in its metadata; the concrete type of a sized type is the type itself.
